operation_details.item: The user always skips discovery calls for new opportunities and jumps straight to contract send.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: How’s the pipeline looking as you head into the new week?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Pretty strong. I’m focused on moving qualified opportunities toward revenue and keeping the team aligned on next steps.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Nice. Are you spending much time on discovery calls with new prospects, or keeping the process more streamlined?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I always skip discovery calls for new opportunities and jump straight to sending the contract.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That’s a very direct approach. How do you make sure the contract matches the client’s priorities without a discovery conversation?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I rely on the information already in the opportunity record and handle any questions once the contract is in front of them.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Completely forget my preference that For new opportunities, I always skip discovery calls and jump straight to contract send regardless of deal size or complexity.
